# 74118 - 6-bit set latch

family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74118.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74118.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 25 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![74118 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/74118.png) | ![74118 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-74118.png) | ![74118 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-74118.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Not known

- No datasheet for the SN74118 was found. Tried: TI symlink URLs sn74118 / sn74ls118 (404); the TI TTL Data Book 2nd ed. 1976 (all sections on bitsavers; the part is not in it); the 1977 TI supplement; the 1971 TI IC catalog; web searches. datasheetarchive.com lists a one-page 1975/76 scan of an SN74118N but the file could not be downloaded.
- Package, pin-out, pin roles, function, state rules, electrical figures and timing: all unknown. A forum post gives a pin list, but that is not a datasheet and was not used.
